info.title: FeraRender API
info.summary: Complete contract for templates, components, datasets, mappings, PDF/DOCX/XML rendering, and lifecycle
info.description: Source-traced FeraRender contract reconciled to compact and conventional Express routers. It documents all 46 canonical operations, 46 aliases, document media modes, input safety limits, permissions, compiler/converter failures, and lifecycle HMAC.

post.description: FeraRender directly posts one exact-body HMAC callback after lifecycle success or failure. It has no internal retry loop; a failed success callback fails the source request so FeraHooks can redeliver the idempotent event.
